title: Freedom Yield Metal — A-chain Anchor Receipt v2 (HC-single 4-action pack)
description: Formal contract for /api/anchor-receipt.json under the 2026-07-01 anchor design revision (see docs/ANCHOR_SOURCE.md + memory/project_merkle_dag_identity_anchor_design_20260701). v2 shifts the on-chain shape from a single eosio.token::transfer (memo 'fyid1:<dag_root>') to a 4-action pack in ONE transaction: three memos carrying per-branch canonical hashes (identity / observations / artifacts) plus a fourth memo carrying the composed dag_root as a summary. Memo prefix scheme: fya<S>c<N>-<branch>:<hex> and fya<S>c<N>:<hex>, pivoted from fyid1v1c* after the 2026-07-01 mainnet accident tx 997881e844befaf9c159c741988fe99e8ca566a52e539639ab83517b1f36100a permanently occupied the old namespace. The v1 schema (/api/anchor-receipt.schema.v1.json) remains reachable for at least 18 months from v2 publication for consumers of the pre-2026-07-01 receipts; v2 is the forward format. Companion generator: scripts/sign-anchor-event.sh + scripts/gen-anchor-receipt.sh.

schema_version.description: Receipt schema major. v2 covers HC-single 4-action pack receipts.

schema_version_of_source.description: schema_version of the anchor-source.json that produced this receipt.

chain_backend.description: Label for the execution stack that actually served the inscribing transaction. For metal-a-chain this is 'antelope' (Antelope/EOSIO interfaces — /v1/chain, /v1/history, Hyperion /v2/history — and the Antelope action model this receipt's own verify gates assert). Receipts generated before 2026-08-17 carry 'pulsevm', which was a forward-looking label for the announced Metallicus execution engine rather than an observed fact; it becomes correct only once Metal A-chain actually runs PulseVM.

actions.description: Order (normative for verification): identity, observations, artifacts, dag_root_summary. dag_root_summary.root_hex MUST equal sha256(identity.root_hex || observations.root_hex || artifacts.root_hex).
